subject: Re: SKU bundling, trial-link placement, and compliance notes for AWS offer
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Erin Taylor <erin.taylor@acme.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AWS listing copy + SKU bundling / trial link question

Hi Erin,

Thanks again for running through the listing draft on our call yesterday. Attached is a cleaned-up version of the product page copy and our proposed SKU bundling options.

Quick asks so we can finalize the Marketplace page:

- Confirm which SKUs you want public vs. private (bundle A = core inference, bundle B = inference + premium support).
- Do you want a self-serve 14-day trial (activation via marketplace "Get started") or a gated trial that requires a sales touch? If self-serve, we need the activation URL (or we can host a short activation flow) — see screenshot stub attached.
- Any procurement/legal footnotes we should add (PO flow, EULA variations)?

I've cc'd Kimberly for copy tone and Sean for procurement/SLA alignment. Please review the attached files and the inline comments in the doc.

Attachments:
- acme_offer_draft.docx (draft product page copy)
- sku-mapping-v2.xlsx (proposed SKU bundling)
- screenshots-trial-flow.png (mockup of Get started -> trial activation)

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Marketplace GTM Lead
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
From: Erin Taylor <erin.taylor@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-09-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing copy + SKU bundling / trial link question

Marissa,

Thanks — reviewing now. A few quick answers:

- We prefer two SKUs: 'Acme AI Inference (standard)' and 'Acme AI Inference + Priority Support'. Public listing for standard; the bundle with support should be private/contract-only.
- We prefer a self-serve 14-day trial. Ideally the marketplace Get started button would call your trial activation endpoint. Our security team requires the trial activation to validate customer org domain and accept our trial terms (attached as trial_terms.pdf).
- Procurement-wise, we need net-30 invoicing for paid conversions; I can send the PO contact.

I'll go through the copy and leave comments in the doc. One product note: please avoid the phrase 'fully managed' — our legal asked to use 'hosted and supported'.

Erin
Head of Cloud Partnerships
Acme Corp
erin.taylor@acme.com
(555) 312-9987

Subject: Re: AWS listing copy + SKU bundling / trial link question

Marissa / Sean — forwarding Erin's replies with my redlines.

Key copy changes I'm proposing (inline in attached doc):
- Swap 'fully managed' -> 'hosted and supported' per Erin.
- Tighten hero one-liner to emphasize latency and cost predictability: 'Production-grade LLM inference with predictable latency and cost.'
- Rework 'Get started' CTA text to 'Start 14-day trial' and include microcopy under the CTA: 'No credit card required; trial activates immediately.'

Procurement/Security notes for Sean:
- Erin's trial activation requirement (validate org domain + accept trial terms) means we should host the activation endpoint. I can add a short 'activation flow' description to the marketplace copy that links to a hosted activation page (see related link below).
- Also flag: for EU customers we need a data residency footnote — let's make that conditional copy.

Attachments:
- acme_offer_copy-redlines.docx

Kimberly Park
Marketplace Content
kimberly@redwood.com

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-06T10:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing copy + SKU bundling / trial link question

Hi Erin — thanks for the quick answers. Attached is the consolidated copy and a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we can get the listing live next week. Highlights:

- We've updated hero and CTA per Kimberly's redlines.
- We're proposing the 14-day self-serve trial. To meet your security ask we'll implement a quick org-domain check and a terms acceptance modal on activation.
- Public vs private SKUs updated per your preference; private SKU will require private offer flow and PO.
- Procurement: Sean will follow up on net-30 invoicing and PO contact.

MAP (high level):
- Today: Acme approves final copy + provides PO contact and trial_terms.pdf confirmation (Erin)
- +1 business day: Redwood pushes copy to AWS listing and shares preview link (Marissa)
- +2 business days: Trial activation endpoint (Aditya) deployed to staging for Acme QA
- +3 business days: Go-live to public listing (subject to AWS approval)

Attachments:
- acme_offer_final-v1.docx
- MAP-acme-marketplace.pdf

Would you please confirm approval on copy and confirm the PO contact? We're targeting the listing publish on Friday if approvals come through.

Thanks,

Marissa

Everything looks good — approved. PO contact is jayne.brooks@acme.com and I've confirmed our legal approves the copy changes. We accept the self-serve 14-day trial flow.
